correctness.rationale: Proposition 2.1 of arXiv:1906.08806 identifies the exact independent-parent model. Edge deletion establishes the conditional stochastic order; indicator factorizations give exact influences and covariance. Pairwise terminal probabilities yield the full variance. Uniform Taylor bounds and Riemann sums prove both variance limits and the Pearson constant. Independently replayed exact rational parent-choice census verifies n=3..7, and sum identities n=3..120; no finite check is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Components measure distinct genealogical lineages, while terminal vertices measure current branch ends. The strictly ordered conditional influences quantify birth-age dependence, and the positive global correlation (~0.631) contrasts with negative pairwise terminal associations. The covariance/variance limits describe persistent macroscopic dependence beyond marginal degree or component-count laws, a natural observable question in the stationary genealogy.
